title: Coconut Custard Pie
ldIngredientsRaw: ½ recipe Perfect Pie Crust ( or store bought pie crust)
½ oz corn starch (1 ½ tablespoons )
ldInstructionsRaw: Roll the pie dough and line a 9" pie pan. Crimp the edges of the shell. Use a fork to dock the bottom of the crust 3 or 4 times. Refrigerate the pie shell while you preheat the oven.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F. Line the chilled pie shell with aluminum foil and fill the foil with pie weights, dry beans or granulated sugar (see note).
Bake the pie shell for about 15 minutes, until the dough is set but still pale.
When the pie shell comes out of the oven place a sheet pan onto the bottom rack of the oven to preheat.
